messages:
Leah (CS): NimbleLaw reached out today — they want to onboard a contract summarizer (multilingual: EN/ES/FR). Requirements: extract obligations, dates, parties; redact PHI before storage; private deployment (VPC) + HSM for key management. Timeline: 6 weeks. Renewal flagged as at-risk if compliance/HSM can't be met. Sharing details below.
Jamal (SE): Thanks — do we have sample docs and expected QPS/latency? Also, are they expecting a fine-tuned model or prompt-engineered + small classifier/adapters?
Leah (CS): They emailed a sample bundle (I'll drop to the shared drive). Target workload: ~20 qps, median token latency <250ms. Customer prefers adapter-style fine-tune (LoRA ok) to retain upgrade path.
Priya (Safety): We'll need labeled PHI examples and a redaction spec. Also want clear eval metrics for hallucination/factuality on extracted clauses. Any legal/regulatory constraints from the customer?
Leah (CS): They said DPAs in place, SOC2 required, and they need audit logs retention for 2 years. No special export controls beyond PHI handling.
Jamal (SE): For the eval harness I propose this matrix:
```
- PHI redaction: recall >= 0.95, precision >= 0.90
- Obligation extraction: F1 >= 0.88
- Date/entity normalization: accuracy >= 0.92
- Hallucination: invented-clause rate <= 3 per 100 docs
- Latency: p50 <= 250ms at 20 qps
```
Priya (Safety): Add policy rules: block outputs that present legal advice as attorney-client opinion. Blacklist phrases like "you should consult a lawyer" isn't enough — deny explicit licensing claims. Also require human-in-the-loop for first 1k documents and a disabled fail-open.
Carlos (Onboard PM): I'll set the kickoff — need: customer account id, confirmed budget tier (hosted vs dedicated), signed SOW, and SOC2 attestation. Leah — can you confirm budget and whether they will commit to reserved capacity?
Leah (CS): They're leaning dedicated/reserved capacity if we can guarantee HSM + retention SLAs in contract. Budget is tentative but they'll move fast on pilot if we can offer a 6-week pilot with those controls.
deploy-bot: /onboard create nimblelaw-3612 — checklist created:
- KYC: pending
- SOW: pending
- HSM integration task created (#task-5678)
Link: https://redwood-internal/onboard/3612
Jamal (SE): I'll run a quick compatibility test: spin a 13B baseline quantized to 4-bit on staging to estimate latency & memory. ETA 48h, will post perf numbers and sample outputs.
Priya (Safety): Please capture the prompt templates and any pre-processing rules so we can run leakage checks. Also require audit logging for redaction decisions (who/what/why).
Leah (CS): I'll book the customer kickoff for tomorrow 10:00am PT and send them the secure upload link for the labeled examples. Marking renewal risk = high; planning to push pilot commercial terms. :crossed_fingers:
Carlos (Onboard PM): Thx team — I'll create the internal SOW draft and tag legal. Next update after Jamal's perf run or after the kickoff, whichever is earlier.
thread_summary: NimbleLaw wants a private, HSM-backed multilingual contract summarizer. CS flagged renewal risk; team coordinating eval metrics, redaction/HSM needs, SOW/kickoff, and a 6-week pilot.
